senses.gloss:
कौञ्च m. (-ञ्चः) The name of a mountain, part of the Himālaya range:
see क्रौञ्च.

कौञ्जायनी f. (-नी)
 1. The wife of a Brahman or any venerable personage.
2. A female descendant of Kunja.
 E. कुञ्ज, and फक् affix, fem. affix
[]
ङीष् this word may be masculine, कौञ्जायन m. (-नः) meaning a
male descendant of Kunja; also कौञ्जायन्य formed from कुञ्ज by ष्यञ्
affix m. sing. (-न्यः) sense; also plur. (-नाः.)
